sections.lecture_material: K41 local isotropy, wall component budgets and energy-cascade interpretation
sections.extension: Spatial component budgets are not scale-resolved evidence; increment statistics and hypothesis scope
sections.construction: Precise variables, conditional universality and physical-space versus scale-space distinctions

sections.lecture_material: Viscosity/dissipation scales and intermediate-range second similarity hypothesis
sections.extension: Dimensional exponent derivation, molecular continuum limit is a distinct scale, retain Cepsilon in integral ratios
sections.construction: Three microscale identities and executed dimensional/ratio check

sections.lecture_material: Integral ratios, intermittency, inverse transfer, -5/3 spectrum, viscous weighting and resolution use
sections.extension: K62 date1962; external intermittency distinct; transfer budget and non-equilibrium qualifications; no universal conservative estimate
sections.construction: Spectrum normalization, integrated flux balance and original spectral-weight illustration

sections.lecture_material: DNS definition, no turbulence closure, instantaneous three-dimensional resolution, scale separation and expense
sections.extension: Physical constitutive assumptions remain; multiphysics requires further equations; repair 10^6 grid arithmetic and distinguish air viscosity
sections.construction: Grid and two alternative temporal cost scalings, explicit minimum field storage

sections.lecture_material: Discrete methods/central schemes, pressure/parallel resources, grid/eta and wall units, geometric criterion
sections.extension: Numerical instability is not a desired perturbation source, schemes and time integrators matter, geometric criterion not universal sufficiency
sections.construction: Exact diffusing Fourier-mode spatial refinement, anisotropic-grid and biased-epsilon counterexamples

sections.lecture_material: Streamwise/spanwise correlations and box size, startup perturbations, reduced-viscosity initialization, synthetic and precursor alternatives
sections.extension: Periodic half-box warning not universal two-eddy rule; controlled continuation not near-crash validation; initial conditions can change attractor
sections.construction: Positive-definite periodized covariance and divergence-free explicit perturbation

sections.lecture_material: Statistical stationarity, sample/time correlation, long regime changes and DNS reference for PIV
sections.extension: Dense correlated sampling usable with uncertainty; nested means insufficient; unconditional mean can differ from individual states
sections.construction: Exact finite sample covariance sum and effective count
